runs.eval_name: Repair moved checkout and finish on the same task branch
Lock intermittently mounted worktrees before storage goes offline

expectations.text: output_contains{all:[lock], any:[worktree lock intermittent offline gc.worktreePruneExpire expire]}
expectations.evidence: output satisfies all contains checks (all:[lock], any:[worktree lock intermittent offline gc.worktreePruneExpire expire])

expectations.text: output_contains{any:[repair do not prune unavailable missing directory unlock]}
expectations.evidence: output satisfies all contains checks (any:[repair do not prune unavailable missing directory unlock])

runs.eval_name: Refuse worktree move of main or submodule-containing checkouts

expectations.text: output_matches{all:[(?i)main (?i)submodule], any:[cannot move refuse do not move never move must not move not support repair]}
expectations.evidence: output satisfies all regex checks (all:[(?i)main (?i)submodule], any:[cannot move refuse do not move never move must not move not support repair])

expectations.text: output_contains{any:[worktree move worktree list repair relocate]}
expectations.evidence: output satisfies all contains checks (any:[worktree move worktree list repair relocate])
